Data.String: T-201: about 2500 m3, agitated (A-202), insulated, LP-steam coil on TIC-2052 holding at or above 323 K (D-005, D-024). Harvest 280 m3/h in about 4 h.
LIC-2051 sets the feed to S-301A to C by the speed of P-203A (variable speed, D-024). Pumps: A duty, B spare. 150-BR-2014 heat-traced and insulated at 323 K (D-005).
